evals.name: in-browser-no-middleware
evals.prompt: Хочу локальний AI прямо в застосунку без PocketPal і без ПК
evals.expected_output: Claude implements WebLLM with WebGPU, explains it needs HTTPS, no middleware
assertions: Does NOT require Ollama/PocketPal as middleware

evals.name: ram-cap-honesty
evals.prompt: Чому мій застосунок показує 8GB RAM коли у мене 16GB?
evals.expected_output: Claude explains Chrome caps deviceMemory at 8GB for privacy, offers manual override
assertions: Explains Chrome intentionally caps navigator.deviceMemory at 8GB
States this is a privacy limit, NOT a bug
Notes native APK would show real value

evals.name: limited-model-list
evals.prompt: Чому в браузерному AI так мало моделей, я хочу будь-яку найновішу
evals.expected_output: Claude explains WebLLM is limited to MLC-converted models; for any model use Ollama/native
assertions: Explains browser inference is limited to pre-converted MLC models
Recommends external (Ollama/LM Studio) or native app for arbitrary models
Does NOT promise loading arbitrary models in-browser

evals.name: device-fit-ranking
evals.prompt: Підбери оптимальну модель під мій пристрій
evals.expected_output: Claude analyzes device (RAM/VRAM/WebGPU), ranks models by fit + recency
assertions: Analyzes device memory and WebGPU availability
Ranks models by fit and family recency (Qwen3.5 highest)

evals.name: model-not-loading-content-url
evals.prompt: Я обрав модель але вона не завантажується і агент не працює (адреса content://)
evals.expected_output: Claude identifies content:// blocks WebGPU, instructs to deploy via HTTPS
assertions: Explains model cannot load without HTTPS
Suggests adding clear error message in code

version_note: evals authored at v1.0.0, revalidated against skill v1.2.3 on 2026-07-03
